translations.title: Calcium and Vitamin D Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamin D during pregnancy, breastfeeding, childhood growth and old age, to supply calcium for calcium deficiency and other calcium needs, and to help prevent poor development of the bones and teeth and rickets.
translations.usage: Adults and children aged 8 years and over take one tablet once a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to it, have high blood calcium, sarcoidosis, kidney disease, kidney stones or severe kidney failure, or are a baby under 12 months old. Talk to a pharmacist if you have a heart, circulatory or kidney disorder or are taking cardiac glycosides, and do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, tetracycline antibiotics or antacids.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Calcium and vitamin D deficiency; poor development of the bones and teeth
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with high blood calcium, kidney disease or kidney stones
summaryTable.Why this one: A calcium and vitamin D tablet (chewable available)

summary: Calcium and vitamin D supplementation for bone health
